__Fixed Spawn Locations__

Most Blood Eagle spawn locations can be identified by the Blood Eagle icon on the map.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ed0bd5763e58495895fd2530b8b3b7c0~mv2.jpg)

There are usually two "waves" of enemies at Blood Eagle camps. If you're sneaking and manage to eliminate everyone without being detected, the second wave won't spawn.

If you're hunting for a set number of kills or looking to maximize enemy spawns, let yourself get spotted—so a Blood Eagle can then run over and activate the alarm bell. This will trigger the second wave and bring in more enemies.

**Unmarked Location # 1**

**Twin Pine Cabins**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_41f4f876f9864cf6bc6c8644d4efd215~mv2.jpg)

I recommend placing a custom map marker to help guide you just in case the directions below aren’t completely clear.

From the spawn-in location, turn and face **northwest (NW)**. Run straight ahead for a while—you’ll pass through a lot of trees. Eventually, you’ll spot some classic Raider-themed clutter on your left: a tire, canvas sails, poles, a porta-potty, and similar objects.

Head over to that camp area, and the Blood Eagles will spawn.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_954fba5d5ec34543af6de86174585d49~mv2.jpg)
